new_in_run16.goal_discovery: FRONTIER EXPLORATION engaged live (frontier_batches=2): when the adopted program had high live confidence but is_win never fired and no goal plan existed, the agent planned coverage-maximizing action prefixes on CPU (planner.explore_frontier BFS over the model's reachable-state graph) and executed them open-loop with expect divergence-abort, watching every real transition for a level/score boundary.
new_in_run16.model_trusted_fast_path: engaged live (reflect_skipped=3): while the rolling live-prediction window all passed, the reflect LLM call was skipped (log-only) and planned batches extended toward the budget-guard cap; any live miss instantly restored full decide/reflect cadence.
new_in_run16.crash_fix: first launch of run 16 died 17 min in when one REPAIR decide call hit the ollama client timeout and the LlmError propagated uncaught through _handle_divergence -> run(), killing the run with no artifacts. _decide now catches LlmError and degrades to an unusable-response fallback (reactive probe / failed candidate). The relaunched run survived 6 failed repair attempts and ran to the full budget.

environment_note: The zonoid daemon on :8787 was CPU-pegged and mostly unresponsive throughout (KB search failed x4, all graph POST/GET timed out early); ORIENT still recalled the run-15 dev-repaired program natively on a later retry when the daemon answered intermittently. The loaded machine also slowed ollama (the cause of the first launch's timeout crash).
why_no_level_cleared: NO level cleared (levels_completed=0, won=false, stop_reason=budget). The recalled dev-repaired program again held essentially perfectly (live_pass_rate=1.0 over the 11-transition live window; 6 transient-divergence REPAIR attempts all failed extract/compile and the recalled program correctly held). GOAL DISCOVERY frontier exploration engaged (2 batches) and the fast path skipped 3 reflect calls, lifting session throughput from run-15's 17 actions/25min (0.68/min) to 20 actions/25.3min (0.79/min) — but the first-ever level boundary was never observed within budget, so is_win was never re-derived and planning stayed goal-blind. The bottleneck remains LLM latency on the loaded machine: 13 decide + 8 reflect calls plus 1 synth session and 6 repair decide calls, each taking minutes on the 35B local model while the pegged daemon competed for CPU. The frontier explorer needs the model adopted EARLY to spend the budget exploring; here adoption landed only after a failed synthesis cycle burned the first ~15 minutes (ORIENT's first attempts lost to daemon KB timeouts).
repair_outcomes_note: 6/6 REPAIR candidates failed extract/compile (adopted:false, no validation report); same profile as run 15 — qwen-coding cannot emit a compiling world-model program under the repair prompt.
